Nearest City: Clarksville, TN

Medium Affected: SUBSURFACE
Suspected Responsible Party: AMX ENVIRONMENTAL SOLUTIONS, LP
Skytruth Analysis
///WEB REPORT///AT APPROXIMATELY 10:00 A.M., ON WEDNESDAY, APRIL 26, 2006, A MERCURY SPILL WAS DISCOVERED ON THE NORTH SIDE OF THE TRANE FACILITY, FACING DUNLOP LANE BY A PLANT ENGINEER. SPECIFICALLY, THIS AREA IS LOCATED OUTSIDE OF THE BOILER ROOM, NEAR THE LABORATORY, ON THE ASPHALT. THERE WERE SEVERAL PUDDLES OF MERCURY VISIBLE ON THE GROUND NEAR SOME LARGE METAL COMPONENTS OF VARYING SIZES. THE METAL COMPONENTS WERE BEING TEMPORARILY STAGED AS A RESULT OF BOILER DEMOLITION WORK BEING PERFORMED ON BOILER NO. 3, INSIDE OF THE PLANT IN THE BOILER ROOM AREA, BY AMX ENVIRONMENTAL SOLUTIONS, L.P. IT IS UNKNOWN WHEN THE SPILL ACTUALLY OCCURRED. TRANE'S ENVIRONMENTAL COORDINATOR, VIEWED THE SITE AND CONTACTED FIRST RESPONSE, INC.

THIS RELEASE OF DRILLING FLUID WAS SUBSEQUENT TO THE RELEASE ESTIMATED TO HAVE BEEN UP TO 59 BBLS OF SYNTHETIC-BASED DRILLING FLUID RELEASED THE PREVIOUS DAY (NRC CASE NUMBER 780340).

THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE POSSIBLE OIL APPEARED TO BE THE RESULT OF A BILGE DUMPING FROM A SOUTHBOUND VESSEL LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 200 NMI SOUTH OF THE MOUTH OF THE MISSISSIPPI RIVER. THE POSSIBLE OIL EXTENDED NORTHWARD APPROXIMATELY 9.9 NMI FROM THE VESSEL, AND WAS UP TO 0.3 NMI IN WIDTH. THE ANOMALY WAS DARK AGAINST ITS BACKGROUND AND AWAY FROM NATURAL SEEP AREAS, THOUGH ITS APPEARANCE WAS NOT PARTICULARLY WELL-DEFINED. THERE WERE INDICATIONS OF FEATHERING ALONG THE ANOMALY. WINDS AT THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE FROM THE E AT ABOUT 15 KTS. UNCERTAINTIES: A PORTION OF THE ANOMALY COULD HAVE BEEN THE RESULT OF A VESSEL WAKE, ALTHOUGH THE WIDER AREAS SUGGESTING FEATHERING WERE MORE LIKELY THAN THE REST OF THE ANOMALY TO BE OIL. THERE WAS AN ADDITIONAL AREA OF POSSIBLE OIL ABOUT 35 NMI NORTH OF THE SUSPECTED SOURCE VESSEL, BUT IT WAS DISCONNECTED FROM THE MAIN ANOMALY AND WAS IN AN AREA OF NATURAL SEEPS.
